title: Run and trace a codebase you did not write
purpose: A messy practice system running on your machine, and a ticket traced through it end to end.
why: Day one on a team is code someone else wrote. Reading a system before changing it is the skill a hiring manager is trying to see.
evidence: Your trace notes: how one request moves through the system, and where you would change it.

tasks.title: Get the practice system running locally
tasks.done_when: It runs, and you wrote down the one thing that did not work the first time.

tasks.title: Trace one ticket from the request to the database and back
tasks.done_when: A page another engineer could follow without asking you a question.
